question: Is the Great Commission for every Christian?
answer: Yes. Jesus told His disciples to "make disciples of all the nations" and to teach them "to keep everything I have commanded you" (Matthew 28:19–20), which includes the command to make disciples. So the commission passes from each generation of believers to the next. Not everyone is called to go overseas, but everyone can take part by going, sending, praying and giving.

question: What is the gospel in simple words?
answer: God made us to know Him, but "Everyone has sinned, and all come short of God's glory" (Romans 3:23). Jesus, God's Son, died for our sins, was buried and was raised on the third day (1 Corinthians 15:3–4). We receive Him by faith, for "all who call on the name of the Lord will be saved" (Romans 10:13).

question: How do I share my faith with friends and family?
answer: Start with your own story: what your life was like before Christ, how you came to trust Him, and what difference He has made, just as Jesus told one man to "Go home to your own people, and let them know all that the Lord has done for you" (Mark 5:19). Pray for the people you hope will come to Christ by name. Speak with love, courage and wisdom, letting your conversation be "gracious and seasoned with salt" (Colossians 4:6).
